string.text: Wear-resistant screw
Rebuilding the screw mechanism and replacing its parts with wear-resistant analogues significantly increases the reliability of its operation and reduces the number of misfires.
Modification of the cartridge supply unit
Refinement of the ammunition supply unit makes it possible to reduce the number of delays associated with non-feeding of the cartridge and its misalignment during reloading.
Heavy Duty Parts
Replacing standard parts with analogues made from high-strength alloys increases the weapon's resistance to wear and extends its service life.
Rail fastenings
Installing rail mounts on the forend allows you to equip the weapon with various tactical equipment.
Lightweight forend
Replacing the standard forend with a lightweight one allows you to slightly reduce the weight of the weapon.
Laser pointer

Visually indicates the location of the intended hit on the target, greatly facilitating and speeding up aiming, as well as having a demoralizing effect on the victim.Does not interfere with the installation of a tactical flashlight and can be used in conjunction with it.
Tactical flashlight

A narrowly focused, long-range flashlight is indispensable in night forays, as well as when exploring and clearing dark rooms.Does not interfere with the installation of a laser pointer and can be used in conjunction with it.
Tritium inserts
Installing luminous inserts in sights allows you to increase the speed of aiming and the convenience of firing in the dark.
Anatomical handle
The handle, custom-made taking into account the anatomical features of the hand, provides a more comfortable grip for the right hand.
Butt pad
Allows you to soften the felt recoil from a weapon shot.
Changing the barrel cutting pitch
Increases the initial speed of the bullet, due to which the bullet deviates less from the expected trajectory and reaches the target faster.Useful for long range shooting.
Barrel adjustment
Allows you to reduce the spread of bullets, which has a beneficial effect on the accuracy of firing.
Change caliber

Comprehensive modification of weapons for a more powerful 9x19 mm caliber cartridge.It should be especially noted that during this alteration, exclusively new and original parts are installed, produced at the plant for other, less common, modifications of the Bison (don’t even ask through what channels they enter the Zone).The final result fully complies with the factory canons and is devoid of the disadvantages inherent in artisanal alterations.Due to the fact that 9x19 mm ammunition is long, the magazine capacity after conversion is 53 rounds.
Forcing USM
Refinement of the firing mechanism components makes it possible to increase the weapon's rate of fire, unfortunately, at the cost of some reduction in reliability.
USM calibration
Individual fitting and balancing of standard parts of the firing mechanism allows for higher shooting accuracy while reducing recoil.
Improved extractor
This modification to the spent cartridge ejection unit allows us to reduce the number of delays that occur during shooting due to the stuck cartridge case.
Shutter Balancing
Balancing the bolt group parts reduces the barrel moving away from the aiming line when firing.
Spring replacement
Allows the bolt group to return to its original position faster, due to which the rate of fire from the weapon increases slightly.
Light alloy parts
Replacing standard parts with analogues made of light alloys significantly reduces the weight of the weapon.
